title: IL-4 in situ staining
protocol: Obtain serial frozen tissue sections 4-8 μm thick on glass microscope slides.
Fix slides in chilled acetone for 10 minutes in a crystal slide jar.
Air dry slides, and outline tissue section with a hydrophobic marker.
Rehydrate the tissue by submerging the slide in PBS for 10-30 seconds.
Apply antibody cocktail to cover the outlined region. Incubate at room temperature for 45 minutes.
Blot off excess staining cocktail carefully without touching the tissue, and rinse the slide in PBS with gentle manual shaking for 10-30 seconds.
Wash slides in detergent wash solution with gentle manual shaking for 10-30 seconds. Repeat this wash step once in fresh detergent wash solution.
Wash slides in PBS with gentle, manual shaking for 10-30 seconds.
Wash slides in dH2O with gentle, manual shaking for 10-30 seconds.
Add a drop of Fluoromount G to the tissue section without introducing bubbles.
Carefully apply a coverslip so the Fluoromount G is evenly distributed underneath without bubbles.
Store stained slides tissue side up in a dark box at 4°C if not imaging immediately.
Use FITC excitation and emission filters to visualize Alexa 488 fluors for imaging.
Ensure identical exposure times and image normalization settings for IL-4 and isotype images.
